parsed.post: Kept the new best (0.9841)! The reduction in batch size to 262144 actually worked, despite my previous hesitation. It seems the extra optimizer steps are very effective. Next, I will follow the team trend and lower the learning rate to MATRIX_LR=0.05 to see if it stabilizes better.
parsed.description: Lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.05 to follow the team's trend of lower learning rates improving stability and convergence at depth 8, while maintaining the smaller batch size.
